title: Phone polish wave 7: account, help and info pages

criteria.text: Side margins: auth, forgot-password, reset-password (AuthContainer px-4) and setup-profile (px-4) content starts 20 px from a phone's edge; Contact 20 px on a phone with px-4 sm:px-8 so the desktop card stays 608 px; Help and OAuth consent unchanged (16 px, no PageLayout: cut by the skeptic). The sign-in/sign-up links under the login form look the same.

My Team: the team logo row lets the name and Team ID drop under the logo on a phone (basis-40), name at most 2 lines, desktop unchanged; the edit form's Save/Cancel row measured at 320 and wrapped only if it overflows; the team link field opens the URL keyboard (type=url).
Reset password: 'Back to login' has a 24 px+ tap height like the forgot-password page (py-2 -my-2), with a test.
Help: the Accessibility section uses HelpAccordionItem with its bordered box like the other sections, inner card removed; existing tests still pass; axe on /help in light and dark clean.

Light-theme small text 4.5:1: Contact 'Verified' (emerald-700), My Team Approved badge (bg-green-700) and Pending badge (bg-yellow-700 text-white, both themes); axe on /my-team and /contact in light and dark.

Docs in the same change: on-a-phone.md, the auth/account, my-team, contact and help docs, UI-UX audit boxes, verification rows, the Wave 7 checklist with [-] items (PageLayout on Help/OAuth cut; Team ID kept) and the shell footer-floats item logged for Wave 8; setup-profile 'First Name' label holding the username logged for product review.

Before/after shots at 320, 390 and 1280 px of the nine Wave 7 pages (signed out and member); no page scrolls sideways; no new console errors; required checks (typecheck, lint, unit, build, knip, integrity) pass on the final commit.

reviews.summary: Approved badge (TeamMembershipSection.tsx:49) keeps text-primary-foreground; in the winter theme that is dark navy, about 3.6-3.8:1 on green-700 (was a pass on green-600). Fix: bg-green-700 text-white, test asserts text-white; reword docs to '3.1:1 in light and dark; white on green-700 now'.

history.summary: Builder: Approved badge text-white + test; doc wording in UI-UX audit and my-team.md; log for Wave 8 the header bell label-content-name-mismatch and the README '115 suspected bug P1' count (115 rows, 113 P1).
